description.zh: 应用唯一标识，可以包含小写字母、数字，长度为6个字符。
description.en: The unique identifier of the application. The value can contain lowercase letters and digits and is 6 characters in length.
The unique ID of the live stream resource.

description.zh: 房间ID，支持英文和数字，最大长度36个字符。
description.en: The room ID. The value can contain letters and digits and is up to 36 characters in length.

description.zh: 创建直播的UserId，在AppId下单独唯一。小写英文、数字、下划线（_）和小数点（.）组成，最大长度32个字符。
description.en: The user ID of the live stream creator. The value must be unique within the AppId. The value can contain lowercase letters, digits, underscores (_), and periods (.) and is up to 32 characters in length.
